adapter.augmentation: fixed A2 roots; no trajectory augmentation
adapter.early_value_states: root legal action values plus target-policy values at depths 1, 2, 5 on both delayed branches; all nonterminal states in two-round controls
adapter.late_value_states: last nonterminal depth on both delayed branches
adapter.q_value_continuation: own current epsilon-greedy online-Q policy against the frozen current native opponent episode mixture; public-prefix-conditioned component weights; own-role utilities

counter_unit: two own-side fresh records per simultaneous round; supplemental records included
q_eligibility: exclude only the passive pre-forcing root; keep own forced action and normal suffixes
q_loss: mean squared error against projected expected one-step targets
record_clocks: aggregate fresh records drive budget/epsilon/opening/ramp; eligible Q records drive Q reuse and target refresh
target_refresh_order: after optimizer work at exact fresh-Q-record boundary
